title: Enhanced Adventures+
description: A modern enhanced modpack for enhanced gameplay.
body:
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af80c88b639b7a951a06332b6470b2214b533e20.png)

## Features that the modpack has and why you should play it:
### Massive world generation: 
since [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/mod/tectonic) the mod has gotten a MASSIVE but MASSIVE world generation, with now more improved continents, the Nether includes a new world generation thanks to [Amplified Nether](https://modrinth.com/mod/amplified-nether) and for the End Dimension [Enderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape)

### New visuals: 
I recommend using Eclipse or Bliss Unstable shaders, since Eclipse has more improved clouds, moon, and shader grass, eclipse events, etc. But the modpack has Complementary Reimagined/Unbound and with/out Euphoria Patches, Complementary Shaders aren't compatible with [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) officially here in Modrinth, but you can find it available in [EminGT](https://modrinth.com/user/EminGT)'s patreon right [here](https://www.patreon.com/c/emingt/home).

### Better F5: 
_What a boring third person right?_, well the modpack has a mod called [Shoulder Surfing Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/shoulder-surfing-reloaded), which adds a new "Third Person"
to the game, like those RPG games, for example **Elden Ring**. What if I want to customize the "F5" view thingy? You can install [Camera Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-utils) which adds a totally customizable F5. _**CAMERA UTILS ISN'T COMPATIBLE WITH SHOULDER SURFING RELOADED, DELETE SHOULDER SURFING RELOADED OR THE GAME WILL CRASH.**_

### Better Combat: 
Simply, there's a mod called [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat) that overhauls the gameplay to have an inmersive gameplay.

### Before playing:
I recommend allocating 4GB of RAM or more to get a stable performance, or if your game crashes you can try deleting Voxy.

  **Q&A**
- **Where do I get Eclipse or Bliss Shaders for Voxy Support?**

    Go to Merlin's GitHub (Eclipse Shaders) [here](https://github.com/Merlin1809/Eclipse-Shader) and X0nk's GitHub (Bliss Shaders) [here](https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader/tree/Unstable)

- **My game crashes or it doesn't open, what can I do?**

  Try deleting [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) in your mods folder. This happens when your hardware isn't compatible with OpenGL 4.6. And if isn't compatible, you can try with [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons).
